reason: This is a DeepSeek Harness automation plugin that modifies first-turn session setup by limiting the exposed tool schema and optionally adding a structural preamble, then defers to normal full tool behavior afterward. Evidence from the README and package manifest shows it is narrowly scoped to initial prompt assembly and session-level first-turn control, making it a workflow-shaping utility rather than a data-processing or content-generation plugin.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，用于在新会话首轮只保留指定工具并可添加结构化提示词，再自动恢复后续回合的完整工具行为。
summaries.en: This plugin for DeepSeek Harness limits exposed tools on the first turn, optionally adds a short preamble, and then lets subsequent turns use the normal full tool setup.

capabilities: Intercepts the system-prompt assembly pipeline for each session turn
Filters tool schema on first turn to a configurable whitelist
Prepends an optional structural preamble on first turn
Restores full behavior on later turns after first assembly

reasons.code: README states this plugin hooks dsh system-prompt/assemble and applies tool pruning plus preamble only on the first session turn, with later turns unchanged
Configuration section documents whitelistedTools and enforcePreamble/customPreamble options controlling first-turn behavior
Package manifest declares a dsh bundle patch entry, indicating activation is via profile bundle wiring rather than automatic global behavior
